data.title: Senior Computer Vision Engineer, Real-Time 3D Tracking
data.description:
Full-Time · Remote (Canada) · Eterio Realities Inc. / Fabstation [Salary range: $ 160,000 - 200,000 CAD About the Role Fabstation puts AR work instructions directly onto structural steel during fabrication. Our software runs on AR tablets and headsets on real shop floors across North America, overlaying CAD-driven guidance onto multi-tonne steel assemblies during fit-up, welding, and inspection. We are cash-flow positive, growing fast, and used daily in production. We are hiring a Senior Computer Vision Engineer to own our real-time 3D object tracking capability: locking a CAD model onto a physical steel member and keeping it locked as the user moves around it. Tracking is core to our product, and we build it in-house. You will build on internal groundwork already underway and own the road from there: architecture, implementation, optimization, and production hardening. This is a role for someone who wants to own a hard, central problem end-to-end and see it shipped into the hands of real tradespeople, not maintain someone else's pipeline. What You'll Do - Own the on-device object tracking core end-to-end, from architecture through production - Design and implement real-time, model-based 6DoF pose estimation and continuous tracking for textureless steel structures, using CAD models as the tracking reference - Fuse object tracking with platform world tracking (visual-inertial odometry), depth, and IMU data; own tracking-loss detection, drift management, and recovery - Optimize native C++ vision pipelines for iOS and Apple silicon: rendering, CPU/GPU budgets, and sustained frame rates on iPad or headset hardware - Extend tracking to large structures: partial visibility, multi-region strategies, and CAD mesh preprocessing from IFC/STEP - type exports - Integrate native modules with Unity via a plugin bridge, and work with our Unity team from prototype through release - Define tracking quality metrics and benchmark against real shop-floor conditions: occlusion, mixed lighting, and cluttered scenes of visually similar material Required Qualifications - 5+ years of professional experience in computer vision or a closely related field, with a focus on real-time systems - Shipped at least one real-time computer vision feature on a mobile platform (iOS or Android) - Strong modern C++; Python is an asset - Solid foundation in 3D geometry: camera models, calibration, projective geometry, and linear algebra - Working command of nonlinear least-squares optimization (Gauss–Newton / Levenberg–Marquardt) and pose parameterization on SE(3) - Hands-on experience with pose estimation and object tracking algorithms - Experience integrating native C++ libraries with Unity, or equivalent native-mobile plugin experience - Strong profiling and optimization skills on ARM (frame budgets, Instruments or equivalent) - Working proficiency with OpenCV Preferred Qualifications - Model-based 3D object tracking (region-based, edge-based, or hybrid approaches) - Metal and GPU compute on Apple silicon - Visual-inertial odometry or SLAM; ARKit (ARCore an asset) - State estimation and multi-sensor fusion: Kalman filtering, factor graphs (Ceres, g2o, GTSAM), extrinsic calibration, and time synchronization - On-device ML deployment: Core ML, ONNX Runtime, or Unity Sentis; learning-based pose estimation or refinement that has shipped on-device - CAD data handling: mesh processing and decimation, IFC/STEP-style exports - Background in industrial vision, robotics, or augmented reality How to Apply We prioritize applications that demonstrate hands-on, real-time computer vision work. Please include: - A brief introduction and a summary of relevant experience - Links to your GitHub profile, portfolio, or publications - One or two examples of real-time pose estimation, tracking, or 3D vision work you built, links or short write-ups Working at Eterio Eterio Realities Inc. (Victoria, BC) is the company behind Fabstation, an AR-enabled manufacturing execution system for structural steel fabrication. We are a small senior team; you will have direct ownership, direct access to real customer shop floors, and a short path from your code to a tradesperson's hands. Eterio Realities is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. Salary: $160,000 – $200,000 / year

data.title: Senior/Staff Machine Learning Data Scientist
data.description:
Senior/Staff Machine Learning Data Scientist In Brief - We’re an early-stage startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. - TLDR: Independent end-to-end model development with ability to work cross-functionally with Clinical, Engineering, and Product to clarify and prioritize specifications and features for our life-saving AI models. Who We Are Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. What you’ll do As a Senior/Staff Machine Learning Data Scientist, you are not satisfied with training and tuning ML models that predict clinical conditions in patients; you also want to own the effectiveness of your model in the real world. In practice, that means you aren’t afraid to get your hands dirty by writing data mapping code, debugging a specific patient case by following patient data as it moves through our AWS services, or improving the timeliness of your model’s predictions by reading and writing production-grade Python and SQL code. Responsibilities - Model Prototyping: Develop and tune innovative, new ML models and labeler systems based on deep understanding of clinical use cases and state-of-the-art ML methods - Productionizing: The same models that you develop with production-grade Python - Deploying: Identify strategies for improving our production ML-based systems, and write, debug, and deploy production-grade Python code to implement those strategies - Cross-Functional Alignment: Data Science for storytelling – understand model performance and metrics, and present this to technical and non-technical users, both internally and externally Minimum qualifications - Ph.D. in a relevant field plus 3+ years experience shipping ML based software products - Experience owning your ML models from prototyping to production, especially real-time algorithms that update dynamically across time - Experience writing production-grade Python and SQL code to implement and evaluate ML models in production systems - Track record of using statistics and performance metrics to compare end-to-end ML and product performance Preferred qualifications - Experience shipping breakthrough or 0-1 products from end to end, interpreting and leveraging State-of-the-Art methods to do so - Experience using messy clinical and health data to design new products for large Health Systems - Experience with any of the following: PyTorch, PySpark, HL7, FHIR, EHR, time series data, signal processing, MLFlow, anomaly detection, Bayesian statistics, quantile regression, time-series forecasting - You bring passion and enthusiasm to your work, and are excited to join a growing team to Get Stuff Done and save lives! Bayesian Health provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/seniorstaff-machine-learning-data-scientist-bayesian-health

data.title: Director, Data Governance (REMOTE, WA)
data.description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About the Role Are you a curious builder who thrives in a fast-moving, data-driven execution role, curious about how AI can turn quality data into real, operational trust? Veeam's business runs on data flowing from four source systems, v-Power for Sales, Marketo for Marketing, NetSuite for Finance, and Workday for HR, through a governed Databricks Lakehouse to certified outputs consumed by Tableau dashboards and AI agents. The Senior Director, AI-Ready Data Governance has authored the strategy for how this gets governed: a federated, pragmatic model, central standards, distributed ownership, sequenced by outcome so scope is committed on evidence rather than ambition. Continuous, agent-driven scoring keeps watching a certified object's quality on an ongoing basis, well past the moment of sign-off. This is a builder and execution role for a deep subject matter expert, with full autonomy to move fast and deliver results. You will lead highly complex, high-visibility initiatives, shape the approach to problems that arrive ambiguous, and influence organizational direction through the standards you set. The strategy, mission, and vision are set. The job is to run Databricks Unity Catalog as the technical backbone and Atlan as the business-facing catalog on top of it, build the certified Bronze-to-Silver-to-Gold pipeline domain by domain, and make certification, lineage, and continuous scoring real enough that governance becomes a standing rhythm rather than a one-off exercise. AI tooling is moving fast enough that the sequence of what gets built when will keep shifting. What does not shift is the outcome bar: certified data, a live trust score behind it, and a named owner for both. This is a job for someone who is curious by default. Someone who would rather have an agent draft the first pass of a lineage map than wait for a meeting about it, who gets energy from ambiguity because the pace of AI tooling means the plan will keep changing, and who treats data quality as something they are personally accountable for at every level, source system to dashboard to agent output, ahead of whatever a report tells them after the fact. What You’ll Do - Run Databricks Unity Catalog and Atlan as the technical and business-facing backbone of certification, domain by domain - Stand up continuous, agent-driven scoring behind certified data: a live trust score that keeps evaluating after certification, with an automated action attached to it - Own the executive intelligence reporting that gives leadership a real, current answer to how much of Veeam's data can be trusted right now, and why - Register and govern the AI agents that consume Veeam's data, and use agentic tools yourself, daily, to do the work faster. - Align diverse business domain and data owners across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and HR on a defined set of standards. What You’ll Bring - Bachelor's degree in a related field such as Business, data science, information systems, or a quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience - 7+ years of experience in enterprise data governance, data management, or GTM - Hands-on experience running enterprise data governance in production with a demonstrated track record driving a data and AI governance program end to end: setting the standards, getting distributed owners to adopt them, and holding the outcome - Working knowledge of Databricks Unity Catalog and a business-facing catalog layer such as Atlan, including what it takes to certify a metric end to end - Daily use of Claude, Claude Code, or a comparable agent as a core working tool, plus the ability to set guardrails for how others use one - Demonstrated ability to influence organizational direction and shape senior-leader decisions as an individual contributor, without relying on positional authority Bonus Skills - Direct experience with v-Power or comparable CRM extension platforms in a Sales Operations or Revenue Intelligence context - Demonstrated change management experience, moving organizations from resistance to adoption through structured engagement - Depth in AI asset governance, including model registration, MCP service governance, and agentic system access control, ideally with Unity AI Gateway - Experience with Microsoft Purview for sensitivity classification in Azure and Microsoft 365 environments - SOC 2 Type II audit experience, particularly data processing integrity and access control evidence - Experience in a PE-backed or pre-IPO technology company navigating rapid growth - Background in data mesh, data product operating models, or MDM for customer and product entity resolution - External contributions in data platform, governance, or AI infrastructure, and familiarity with DAMA-DMBOK frameworks #remote #LI-TS1 What you'll get - Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares - Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents - Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day - Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program - 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions - Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time - AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost - Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options - Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting - Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning Compensation Transparency Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range. In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off.
